components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single conversion action: Schedule Pickup.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #FFB020; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFB020; color: #07132B; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E89719; border-color: #E89719; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #066FE5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The alternate action, usually Call or Directions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #2F67B7; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; color: #0C479C; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F3F7FC; color: #042E74; border-color: #042E74; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #066FE5; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Linked card for routing visitors to one service page.
components.html:
Wash & Fold

Drop it off and pick it up washed, dried, and folded.
components.css: .ds-service-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; min-height: 220px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid #CFDEF0; border-radius: 14px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #042E74; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(.2,0,.2,1); } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(7,19,43,.06); } .ds-service-card svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; fill: none; stroke: #066FE5; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-service-card h3 { margin: 0; color: #0C479C; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-service-card p { margin: 0; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; }

components.name: Staging Token
components.description: Visible owner-input gap for facts that must not be guessed.
components.css: .ds-swap { display: inline-flex; min-height: 32px; align-items: center; padding: 2px 10px; color: #07132B; background: #FCEAC4; border: 1.5px dashed #E89719; border-radius: 6px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: Laundry Station should feel orderly, repaired, direct, and local. The homepage uses a shop-floor visual language: white and pale-blue work surfaces, navy structural type, squared controls with softened corners, and visible facts instead of promotional noise.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating white and pale-blue bands with one dark footer.
Amber appears only on Schedule Pickup.
Service cards, Board tables, chips, and FAQ rows form the reusable component base.
Unknown owner values render as dashed amber staging gaps, never as guessed copy.

rules.name: The Amber Budget Rule
rules.body: Amber is for Schedule Pickup only, with deep navy text. Never use white text on amber.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Headings stand alone. Do not add kicker, overline, or label text above a heading.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards and tables rest on a hairline border. They lift only when interaction or overlay state requires it.

dos: Do keep the homepage answer-first and local.
Do use the supplied logo and replace photo placeholders with real Laundry Station photography.
Do keep amber rare enough that Schedule Pickup is visible at a glance.
Do leave owner-supplied unknowns as visible staging gaps until confirmed.
donts: Don't add star ratings, review counts, availability figures, savings percentages, or cheapest-language without real evidence.
Don't use "under new management" as a banner or trust-strip phrase.
Don't add decorative eyebrows above headings.
Don't use stock laundromat photos for the hero or Open Graph image.
